name: Pure Faithful Display
description: The game in its own resizable window on Pure Faithful's LWJGL (SDL3): off the old applet frame, sharp on high-density screens, borderless fullscreen, paste through SDL. Needs Pure Faithful's LWJGL component in place of LWJGL 2; without it, it does nothing.
authors: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic's AI), at Studio Quire
